jobs.name: whistle
jobs.subjectPrompt: A recognizable traditional nickel-plated metal sports/police PEA WHISTLE, viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter side angle. A compact cylindrical resonating drum at left has a clearly circular side plate and thin rolled rim. A SHORT straight narrow flattened rectangular blowing tube exits tangentially from the upper-right part of the drum.
jobs.instructions: Draw the actual construction of a classic metal pea whistle: a round drum made of two circular side plates enclosing a short cylindrical chamber, a short straight flattened tubular mouthpiece about HALF the drum diameter in length, and a small clearly visible rectangular fipple/air window on TOP at the tube-to-drum junction. The mouthpiece has parallel straight sides and a dark small end opening facing right. Distinguish the round chamber, short blow tube and top sound window. A tiny rear attachment eyelet is acceptable but no lanyard or chain. Bluish silver worn tin/nickel. Round body on left, mouthpiece right, nearly horizontal overall. The clear round side plate must remain visible. Not a long tapered snout, spoon, frying pan, shoe, bird, melted blob, bulbous teardrop, or a single hollow rectangular nozzle. Do not use any previously generated whistle shape.
